episode.episode_description: Intel has launched its new D-series GPU, opting for a massive memory capacity over raw speed to tackle the growing demands of AI inference.

selected_story.headline: Intel’s New GPU D-Series Targets High-Capacity AI Inference
selected_story.source_title: Intel unveils its GPU D-series for data centers, featuring up to 480GB of LPDDR5X memory, an unusually large capacity to support demanding inference workloads (Efosa Udinmwen/TechRadar)

short.title: Intel’s New GPU D-Series Targets High-Capacity AI Inference
short.description:
By opting for high-capacity LPDDR5X memory over traditional HBM3e, Intel is prioritising memory capacity for large models, though this trade-off results in lower memory bandwidth.
